posts.text: 🏦 UK Chancellor John Healey doubled the bank surcharge from 3% to 6% for 15 months, raising £1.5bn, and lifted tax on £1-plus slot machines to 25% from 2027. Bank and gambling shares rose as investors had feared bigger hikes. #UKBudget #FTSE

🏛️ The Federal Reserve held its benchmark rate at 3.75%-4%, as traders had largely expected, after a quarter-point hike in September. Futures still point to a hike in December; attention turns to Chair Kevin Warsh and Thursday's PCE data. #Fed #Markets

Paying off debt gets easier once you know which one to tackle first. 📋 The free Debt Snowball List (Lite) for Excel and Google Sheets totals up to 10 debts and shows what to pay first and how much. https://marketplus-news.github.io/ #DebtFree #PersonalFinance

🇳🇿 New Zealand's central bank held its key rate at 2.75% in a 4-3 vote, defying markets that had priced a hike as nearly certain. The kiwi fell 1.3% against the US dollar; odds of a December hike dropped to about 41%. FX volatility may stay high. #NZD #Forex

🚗 Stellantis burned €4.0bn ($4.5bn) in industrial free cash flow in Q3, versus €4.3bn a year earlier. Revenue rose 1% to €37.6bn and shares rose 3.6% in early European trade. It still expects positive cash flow in 2027. #Stellantis #Stocks

💷 UK Chancellor John Healey is expected to scrap a planned cut to the cash Isa allowance in today's budget, keeping it at £20,000 rather than £12,000 from April, the Guardian reports. A relief for deposit-reliant banks. #UKBudget #PersonalFinance

💾 SK Hynix shares closed 10.9% higher after record Q3 results: operating profit up 632% year on year, sales above 100 trillion won for the first time. It plans over $25 billion in dividends and buybacks. Chip stocks stay in focus. #SKHynix #Stocks

🛢️ Oil rose after the Houthis said they hit Saudi Arabia's Ras Tanura refinery with a ballistic missile. Brent gained 1.3% to $115.59 a barrel and WTI rose 1.5% to $101.37. Supply risk keeps a premium in crude. #Oil #Markets

⛽ The UK will freeze fuel duty again in Wednesday's Budget and keep the 5p discount, the BBC reports. Tariffs on 100 food items will also go, saving households up to £21 a year. Gilts and the pound will watch the fiscal cost. #UKBudget #GBP

🤖 Nvidia will invest $3 billion in Meta, which plans to raise $95 billion for AI infrastructure through share sales. Meta will expand use of Nvidia's Vera Rubin chips. Both stocks were flat premarket; AI capex remains a key driver for tech. #Nvidia #AI

🇺🇦 Russia hit Ukraine overnight with ballistic missiles and 280 drones, mainly targeting Kyiv; air defences stopped two missiles and 255 drones. In Kyiv one woman was killed and 15 people were injured. Risk sentiment stays fragile. #Ukraine #Markets

🏦 HSBC said profit jumped 32% and it will hand $2.7bn (£2bn) to shareholders, helped by cost cuts and lower legal bills. Its shares still fell over 6% in London, a day before the UK Budget amid calls for higher bank taxes. #HSBC #FTSE

📈 South Korea's economy grew 1.0% in Q3 from the prior quarter and 3.4% year on year, well above the Bank of Korea's 0.3% forecast, as AI chip exports rose. Private consumption fell 0.2%. Chip demand remains a key support for Asian markets. #SouthKorea #AI

🗳️ Israelis vote today in an election seen as a referendum on Netanyahu. Most polls show his coalition losing its Knesset majority, with the opposition also short of 61 seats, pointing to long coalition talks. Regional risk stays in focus. #Israel #Markets

🏦 HSBC's third-quarter pretax profit rose 32% to $9.6 billion, largely in line with estimates, as revenue climbed to $18.6 billion. The bank announced a share buyback of up to $1 billion; its shares fell 2.95% in Hong Kong. #HSBC #Earnings
